rationale: Retain as a CTA discovery candidate with a warning: reproductive protein evidence and cardiomyocyte IHC not detected coexist with somatic RNA including heart 5.1 nTPM in pinned HPA v23. Current HPA 5.0 is a different release; neither value establishes peptide presentation or safety. Transcript-level review strengthens the warning by excluding the benign reading that the heart signal is entirely the epitope-lacking isoform: see the isoform row in cta-reviewed-evidence.
unresolved_evidence: RNA-positive bulk-heart cell of origin unresolved; single-cell heart shows 1 nonzero observation of 40388 cells and does not localize the signal; IHC and RNA donors differ so discordance cannot be resolved within a donor; negative IHC and discovery MS do not establish absence of peptide-HLA. Isoform balance is no longer open: the lete-cel epitope SLLMWITQC occurs only in LAGE-1A and LAGE-1A is estimated at 44.7% and 37.4% of transcript TPM in the two RNA-positive heart samples; those estimates still lack splice-junction validation.
